listing.title: Grateful Dead Live at Hampton Coliseum on 1988-03-26

recording.lineage: 2 Nakamichi CM100/CP4s 1 Nakamichi CM300/CP1 Nakamichi 550 w/Dolby B in OTS. | Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.lineage: Set 2 only Recorded by Dave Cohen 2 Nakamichi CM100/CP4s 1 Nakamichi CM300/CP1 Nakamichi 550>Sony TCD5M (Oade erase head removal modifications) w/Dolby B in OTS.Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions). Transferred by Dave Cohen November 2009.
